name: ROS 2 tf2 turtle-pose transform broadcaster node
summary: Official ROS geometry tutorial node that subscribes to a turtle pose and broadcasts a timestamped world-to-turtle transform, including a derived Euler-to-quaternion helper. It is an installed ROS 2 console entrypoint; the selected file has Apache-2.0 and BSD-2-Clause component terms.

license.scope: Selected file has an Apache-2.0 header, copyright 2021 Open Source Robotics Foundation, Inc., plus a quaternion helper derived from transforms3d under BSD-2-Clause, copyright 2009-2019 Matthew Brett and Christoph Gohlke. Both notice sets apply to their components; retain attribution, terms, disclaimers and applicable notices when redistributing. Pinned BSD terms: https://github.com/matthew-brett/transforms3d/blob/f185e866ecccb66c545559bc9f2e19cb5025e0ab/LICENSE . This is not a choice between licenses or blanket package/dependency clearance.

packages: Compatible ROS 2 rclpy environment with the context-manager init API used by this source
Installed turtle_tf2_py package exposing the reviewed console entrypoint
system: Configured ROS graph publishing the intended absolute /<turtlename>/pose topic
Reviewed turtlename parameter, world/child frame naming and node clock
requirements.notes: The package is labeled version 0.7.0 at a Rolling-branch source pin; neither label establishes a tested ROS distribution, Python version or operating system. The turtlename parameter defaults to turtle. Pose callbacks subscribe to /<turtlename>/pose, stamp transforms with current node time, set parent frame world and child frame turtlename, copy x/y with z=0, convert yaw to quaternion and call sendTransform. Set intended parameters and provide matching pose publishers; this node alone does not create a complete following demo. The exact source imports turtlesim_msgs, whose availability must be resolved in the chosen environment. The copied helper's pinned transforms3d terms were reviewed, but mathematical correctness, clock/frame behavior, package installation and ROS graph compatibility were not executed or tested.

invocation.notes: Installed ROS 2 console command backed by the pinned setup.py registration turtle_tf2_py.turtle_tf2_broadcaster:main. The source defines main without a __main__ guard; direct python-file execution is not the declared node invocation. Starting the console entrypoint initializes rclpy and broadcasts transforms from incoming pose messages. The Hub supplies inert source metadata with no preparation/execution adapter and ran no ROS node, package installer or simulator. A single fetched Python file is insufficient.

access.instructions: Read the pinned node, both component license terms, package declarations and setup registration before use. This source reference does not install or execute code.

evidence.inspection: Complete ROS node read as inert text and Python AST parsed without import or execution. Source, package, setup and Apache license pins matched the complete immutable tree. A separate three-GET review checked the exact linked transforms3d tree, BSD-2-Clause license and Euler source/helper attribution. Component source terms and registered console entrypoint were reviewed; no runtime or physical-controller compatibility is claimed.
